title: DeviceSide test records
description: The files in docs/integrations/<integration>/test-records/: a rig record per suite (<suite>.json, the step file's name: <action>.json or <action>-<option>.json), the maintainers' manual sign-offs (_manual.json) and the facts the rig's fact cases found (_facts.json). The rules they serve are docs/evidence.md's (Sign-off format, The coverage check); scripts/check_release.py and scripts/gen_compat.py read them. A file's integration is its folder's.

integration.description: The integration's key, its bundle's folder name.

calls.description: The git blob id of the action's call transcript, tests/integrations/<integration>/calls/<action>.json, as tested (git rev-parse <commit>:<path>): evidence stands while every segment of it occurs, unchanged, in HEAD's transcript (scripts/check_release.py).

model.description: The model ID: a Zigbee device's Basic-cluster model (e.g. LWA012) on every integration, else the integration's model ID; docs/models.yaml or its bundle's devices.yaml must list it.

firmware.description: As the integration reports it; null when it reports none.

manufacturer.description: The Zigbee manufacturer string as the integration reports it (Z2M bridge/devices `manufacturer`, ZHA's device manufacturer, the Hue bridge's `product_data.manufacturer_name`), else HA's registry manufacturer; null where none was reported or recorded. Never a device name.

class.description: The class the call reached (IntegrationInfo.capability, as the action's result reports it); null where the integration named none, or names no classes, or, for a device not yet placed, the response leaves it out.

record.description: A rig run of one suite. Format 3 is what the rig writes: the devices each test reached, and the call transcript it tested (`calls`). Format 2 is the same, bound to the package tree instead (`package`); it credits classes and cards but is no sign-off. Format 1 is a markdown record converted once, with the run's devices on the record, not per test; it credits as the markdown did and is no sign-off. A rerun replaces formats 1 and 2 with format 3. Counts are derived from the tests, never stored.

action.description: The action the suite tests: its step file's `action`.

options.description: The step file's `options`, sorted; absent when it has none.

result.description: pass when no test failed; a pass record whose tests hold a fail is invalid.

commit.description: The deviceside commit the run tested: provenance, which nothing checks.

package.description: Format 2 only: the git tree of integrations/<integration>/ at the run's commit.

devices.description: Format 1 only: the run's devices, in the order the record listed them.

result.description: A pass record holds no failing test.

contains.description: A pass record holds a passing test: one whose every test was skipped made no call.

record_device.description: Format 1: a device of the run, or a native group (its own entry, not its members).

name.description: The name HA's registry gave the model, where the record named one.

id.description: The case: `<test>[<role>]`, or `<test>[<role>-<n>]` for the n-th entity of a role in the profile (the first keeps `[<role>]`), with ` observed` for a watched case.

domain.description: The domain of the entity the case targeted; absent when it targeted none.

role.description: The profile role the case targets.

result.description: not observed: a watched case nobody watched.

reason.description: Why a skipped case didn't run, e.g. none in the profile.

fact.description: A fact case (a watched case, or a firmware fact's): it runs only with --facts and its result is a row of _facts.json, so a record lists it skipped.

allOf.description: A scene's test is a group's: the one call is the scene's, not its members' (device-classes plan, Decision 27).

test_v1.description: Format 1: a test as the markdown Tests table held it.

group.description: The target was a native group or a scene; added in conversion for a scene's test, whose devices are the record's.

classes.description: The markdown's Capability cell: the classes a passing test reached (a group's members', each once), empty for a dash; absent when the record had no Capability column.

test_v2.description: Formats 2 and 3: a test with the devices it reached. A test that ran lists them, and its domain; a skipped one lists none and says why, unless it is a fact case.

group.description: The target was a native group, or a scene (whose test always carries it): devices are its members, each with its manufacturer and class.

allOf.description: A group role's test that ran is a group's, as a scene's is: without `group`, its devices, the members, would each be credited as tested on its own. Format 1 names no device per test, so the rule is formats 2 and 3's.

manual.description: _manual.json: a maintainer's hand tests, a row each, added in a PR. A format 3 row is a sign-off of each action in its `calls` while that transcript stands (docs/evidence.md, Release gate); a format 2 row (`passed`) credits classes and cards but signs off nothing.

manual_row.description: The devices tested, each with the class it reached, and the actions that passed on all of them (a row credits each class to each action, so split a row whose actions reached different classes): format 3 names each action with the blob of its call transcript as tested (`calls`, which scripts/signoff.py fills from HEAD, or from the tag given with --at), format 2 the actions alone (`passed`).

commit.description: The commit tested (with `reports`, the release the reporters ran): provenance, which nothing checks.

signed_by.description: The maintainer who vouches for the row: one of the integration's maintainers or a repo maintainer. With `reports`, they signed off on the reporters' runs.

reports.description: The users' working reports the row rests on, instead of the signer's own run: issues in this repo.

group.description: The actions targeted a native group, or a scene: devices are its members, each with its manufacturer and class.

calls.description: Format 3: each action that passed, with its transcript's blob.

manual_device.description: A model id (docs/models.yaml or its bundle's devices.yaml, never a household's device name), its manufacturer string and the class it reached; where the model and manufacturer come from: docs/evidence.md, Sign-off format.

firmware.description: Optional: as the integration reported it.

facts.description: _facts.json: what the rig's fact cases found, dated, a row each; rows are only ever added, as each is a fact that stands until evidence contradicts it.

suite.description: The suite's name (its record's file name): case ids repeat across suites.

kind.description: How the fact was seen: automated (a firmware fact's case that passed or failed) or observed (a watched case a person answered).

converted.description: The row was converted from _facts.md: its devices have no manufacturer or class, and keep the name their record gave the model.

fact_device.description: A device the case ran on: with its manufacturer and class, or, on a converted row, with neither and the name its record gave the model.
